# Central Strait

![[_assets/banners/central-strait-banner.webp]]

[[master-kyzil|Master Kyzil]]'s search for [[crissdalynn-khinriss|Crissdalynn]] passed through here on his way from [[midchain|Midchain]]. See [[midchain|Midchain]] for the full account.

The Central Strait is the main trade route through [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/verdant-scatter|the Scatter]]. This corridor of pale blue-green water spans forty to eighty miles wide, running between the [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands|Crown Islands]] to the north and [[midchain|Midchain]] to the south. The water is clear, revealing the sandy bottom on good days. Depth ranges from eighty to two hundred feet. The Scatter Current flows steadily east, adding half a knot to a full knot of speed for eastbound ships. Spinner dolphins hunt the shipping lanes year-round. Flying fish leap from every bow from the western mouth to the Narrows.

Almost everything moving between the colonial homelands and [[midchain|Midchain]] uses the Strait. [[tidefall|Port Tidefall]] collects its price at the western end, extending its [[inspection-pier|Inspection Pier]] across the channel. Nothing enters under Crown law without pausing to answer questions and sign documentation. Eastbound, the Strait narrows as both shores meet at [[tail|the Tail]]. The current speeds up and the water changes before [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/stenmark|Stenmark]]'s cliffs appear.

## Routes & Access

**The Tidefall Gate.** The western entrance is the navigable water between [[calders-tooth|Calder's Tooth]] and the northernmost [[midchain|Midchain]] reefs. Entering the Gate means entering Crown jurisdiction. Ships that try to skirt it without presenting papers find the Crown patrols already know which reef gap they favor.

**The Blue Lane.** The established mid-Strait shipping route follows the strongest line of the Scatter Current, roughly equidistant between the shores. It remains unmarked but universal: the deepest, fastest, and most visible line across the Strait.

**The Calven Roads.** Sheltered water south of [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/calven|Calven]] island provides one of the better northern-Strait anchorages for ships waiting out weather or tide. [[calveno|Calveno]]'s canal city is visible from here on clear days.

**The Harwick Reach.** Deeper water south of [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]] is where Crown patrol frigates stage. A ship on the Blue Lane can see the [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick Naval Yard]]'s masts from mid-channel in calm conditions.

**Sandtable Shoal.** A sandbank in the middle Strait sits south of [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/aldenmere|Aldenmere]], with the bottom rising from two hundred feet to under forty feet over about two miles and shifting the Blue Lane slightly south. A [[kalowe|Kalowe]] operator holds the Crown salvage contract, though the [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]] Admiralty remains dissatisfied with this arrangement.

**The Kalowe Run.** The angled approach from the Blue Lane south to [[kalowe|Kalowe]] cuts through the northern [[midchain|Midchain]] reef approaches. Pilots steer by agreed-upon waypoints, not formal channels.

**The Narrows.** The eastern compression of the Strait narrows corridor width under twenty miles. The current runs fast, and fog lingers later into the morning. The water darkens here as [[the-drowned-maw|the Drowned Maw]]'s influence begins.

### Landmarks

**[[fort-crestwall|Fort Crestwall]].** The fortified Crown post above [[tidefall|Port Tidefall]] is visible from the western approach and south into the Strait on clear days.

**The Pale City.** [[calveno|Calveno]] becomes visible from mid-Strait with pale stone facades catching morning light. The city's height above the waterline makes it legible at distances where most settlements disappear.

**The Yard Masts.** The standing masts and shipway cranes of the [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]] Naval Yard become visible from mid-channel when the weather cooperates.

**The Eyrie Light.** The [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/high-eyrie|High Eyrie]] sea stack is visible from the eastern Strait on clear days as a dark vertical mark on the northeastern horizon. Spotting it confirms you hold the right course to avoid the worst of the Spillback. Pilots call it the Eyrie Light because it confirms position, not because it carries an actual light.

**Stenmark Tower.** The Crown signal station sits on the eastern cliff of [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/stenmark|Stenmark]]. This landmark marks the Narrows entrance. A signal flag warns when [[the-drowned-maw|the Drowned Maw]] acts odd.

## Hazards

Reef sharks hunt shallow water on both coasts. Hunter sharks patrol deeper lanes near [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]]. Giant octopuses hide in wreckage around Sandtable Shoal and the Spillback. Rumors say the [[sawek|Sawek]] is the Strait's top predator. It favors the dark southern [[midchain|Midchain]] approaches, but its range is unknown.

Piracy often uses paperwork as a cover, with small crews lurking at the Tidefall Gate where ships pause for checks. Merchants fear the captain of the [[campaigns/shattered-sea/vehicles/the-bad-receipt|Bad Receipt]] along the south, a Kalowe-built ship that hides behind false papers. When [[campaigns/shattered-sea/factions/the-glass-debt|the Glass Debt]] or [[the-velvet-noose|Velvet Noose]] appear near the Strait, convoys band together and Crown patrols drop their usual routines.

## Geography

The Strait reaches eighty miles wide at its widest point south of [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]], narrowing to forty miles at the western mouth between [[calders-tooth|Calder's Tooth]] and [[midchain|Midchain]]. The eastern end narrows further as the water deepens sharply and the shelf drops away into [[the-drowned-maw|the Drowned Maw]]. Wind and tide rule here. Winds blow northeast to southwest, helping eastbound ships but forcing westbound ships to fight the full length. Fog gathers at night in the east and clears by mid-morning. The western mouth stays clearer.

**The Scatter Current** runs east through the full passage. Its strength peaks in mid-channel and the Blue Lane, weakens near reef approaches. At the eastern end it turns north in a bend pilots call the Cold Turn (or the Fool's Assist for those who watched someone else miss it). Miss the turn. Ships that miss it ride north instead of through. Consequences worsen as they approach [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/stenmark|Stenmark]]'s cliffs.

- North: [[crown-islands|The Crown Islands]]
- East: [[the-drowned-maw|The Drowned Maw]]
- South: [[midchain|The Midchain]]
- West: [[calders-tooth|Calder's Tooth]]

## Trade

The Strait is the region's trade center, with deep water and the Scatter Current helping trade flow. Colonial cargo moves through and ships get checked at entry, while free-port traffic uses the route alongside salvage contracts and escorted convoys. Tidefall collects fees and fishing feeds sea predators.

Dravosi checks at Tidefall act as gates, allowing the Crown to tax trade and gather knowledge. Smugglers win when timing is right and papers look good, but delays and seized cargo raise pressure as weather offers chances for illegal trade. Convoy timing affects politics.

## Notable NPCs

No NPCs live here. The [[campaigns/shattered-sea/vehicles/the-bad-receipt|Bad Receipt]]'s captain has no name in the text.

## Hooks

- Eastbound ships that miss the Cold Turn ride the current north instead of through. Consequences worsen near [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/stenmark|Stenmark]]'s cliffs.
- A [[kalowe|Kalowe]] operator holds the Crown salvage contract for Sandtable groundings. The [[campaigns/shattered-sea/locations/crown-islands/harwick|Harwick]] Admiralty remains unsatisfied with this arrangement.
- When [[campaigns/shattered-sea/factions/the-glass-debt|the Glass Debt]] or [[the-velvet-noose|Velvet Noose]] reports surface near the Strait, convoy schedules shift and Crown patrols abandon routine procedures.
